items.translation: `WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(BodyInserter)` 的快捷方式，使用 值插入器。

items.source: Variant of WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(Publisher, Class) that allows using any producer that can be resolved to Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: `WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(Publisher, Class)` 的变体，允许使用任何可通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 解析为 Publisher 的生产者。

items.source: Variant of WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(Publisher, ParameterizedTypeReference) that allows using any producer that can be resolved to Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: `WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(Publisher, ParameterizedTypeReference)` 的变体，允许使用任何可通过 `ReactiveAdapterRegistry` 解析为 Publisher 的生产者。
`WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(BodyInserter)` 的快捷方式，带有 Publisher 插入器。

items.source: Variant of WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(Publisher, Class) that allows providing element type information with generics.
items.translation: `WebClient.RequestBodySpec.body(Publisher, Class)` 的变体，允许使用泛型提供元素类型信息。

items.source: Contract for specifying request headers and URI for a request.
items.translation: 用于指定请求的请求头及 URI 的合约。
`WebClient.RequestHeadersSpec` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client` 包中的使用情况

items.source: Provides a reactive WebClient that builds on top of the org.springframework.http.client.reactive reactive HTTP adapter layer.
items.translation: 提供基于`org.springframework.http.client.reactive` 反应式 HTTP 适配器层的反应式WebClient。

items.source: Contract for specifying request headers leading up to the exchange.
items.translation: 用于指定交换之前请求标头的合同。

items.source: Contract for specifying the URI for a request.
items.translation: 用于指定请求 URI 的合约。

items.source: Contract for specifying request headers and body leading up to the exchange.
items.translation: 用于指定交换之前请求标头和正文的合约。

items.source: Contract for specifying request headers, body and URI for a request.
items.translation: 用于指定请求的请求头、正文和 URI 的合约。

items.source: Set the body of the request using the given body inserter.
items.translation: 使用给定的主体插入器设置请求的主体。

items.source: Provide a consumer to customize every request being built.
items.translation: 提供一个消费者以自定义正在构建的每个请求。
